consumerSummary: The regulatory treatment of motor-finance commission complaints may change. Some agreements may be considered under an FCA redress scheme, while other complaints may follow the usual lender or Financial Ombudsman route.
complaintRouteSummary: The builder prepares self-service documents for users to review and send themselves. It does not decide eligibility, submit a complaint, represent the user or calculate official redress.
schemeStatus: Check the latest FCA information before sending or escalating a complaint.
legalChallengeStatus: Official rules, complaint handling expectations and court-related developments can change. Do not rely on this page as a final statement of the law or regulatory position.
calculationMethodStatus: No official lender redress calculation is generated by this page. Lender-only information includes commission amount, commission structure, APR adjustment and internal calculations.
warningText: The builder provides self-service document preparation and an illustrative analysis. Check the linked FCA and Financial Ombudsman information before sending your complaint.
